title: Simultaneous normalized quotient/Roos models for primitive completed operations
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, an arbitrary family W of schemes with l invertible in every residue field, and independent site, coefficient and family universes. There exist Models l E W as specified in the completed-operation substitution interface: the full reduction/total-limit calculus, a canonical system RingedSiteDualityModel with equal closed structure, integral_closed equal to IntegralOnSlice.duality, completion with its unit equation, a normalized IntegralComparisonRoosModel at every scheme and an IntegralComparisonPullbackModel for every morphism using these same models. The actual calculus counit is invertible on every normalized system, and the coefficient unit, system tensor and whole-system pullback preserve IsNormalizedCoefficientSequence. This asserts primitive construction and normalization only: it does not assert expression comparison, substitution or structural transport laws.

proof.text: Choose canonical closed total-tensor models on the integral and sequence sites. Present the reduction/total-limit calculus with these same tensors, by transporting its tensor comparisons and adjunctions along the normalized representative comparisons. Choose the integral model to be IntegralOnSlice.duality. This yields the system_closed and integral_closed equalities, without identifying arbitrarily chosen isomorphic structures.

proof.text: The strict quotient tower computes reduction on flat-term K-flat representatives. Apply the normalized natural Roos/total-limit comparison to obtain completion. The strict quotient augmentation identifies its unit with the reduction adjunction unit. For every scheme morphism, form inverse image of this same whole reduction system; the quotient/Roos comparison gives IntegralComparisonPullbackModel, normalized on every simultaneous quotient presentation. One Roos comparison is shared at each scheme.

source.place: Coefficient twists, order 2232; original completed-operation substitution proof steps 1--6: simultaneous quotient/Roos realization and primitive normalization.

proof.text: Identify the actual unit, tensor and pullback transition adjuncts using the normalized system operation models. The unit adjunct is scalar multiplication, tensor uses monoidal scalar extension followed by the input adjuncts, and pullback uses inverse scalar association followed by pullback of the input adjunct. Their cocycles follow from scalar association and the input cocycles, hence all three preserve normalization. Transport through the same normalized representative comparisons of the preceding steps.

proof.text: The canonical reduction/total-limit counit is invertible on normalized whole systems by normalized-DVR effectivity. The projection normalization of the calculus identifies it with the counit in the primitive comparison theorem, so effectivity applies to precisely the specified map. Assemble the data and these four primitive properties; no assertion about expressions or substitution is used.
